data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Horrible customer service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69f02015f616e151850d44d0)
I’ve had a horrible time with customer service. There is no phone number and the chat will refer you to email. I emailed for a refund on my order due to the coffee table being a totally different color than what is shown online and the dining table was broken. I’ve waited two months for this order. Time for a refund. I listed these issues in my email and the email I did receive back (5 days later) stated he would look into finding my order?? What a joke. Don’t order anything from Lulu and Georgia. Big mistake.

April 20, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 28, 2026

Hi Charity,

Thank you for your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you’ve experienced with your order. I understand how frustrating this situation must be, and I want to assure you that our Customer Support team is currently processing your refund for the damaged dining table and handling the return of the coffee table. They will follow up with you shortly to provide a resolution. We appreciate your patience during this time.

Lulu and Georgia
